days.title: Towns and Peninsula of the Southern Shores
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Sirmione
stops.detail: The translation "horned" is also interpreted in reference to the Sirmione peninsula.

stops.name: parco giardino Sigurtà
stops.detail: In the territory there are both protected areas, such as the Mincio regional park, the Castellaro Lagusello nature reserve and the Lake Frassino biotype, and parks and gardens of great importance, such as the famous Sigurtà Garden Park.

days.title: Islands of the Lake
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isola di San Biagio
stops.detail: A short distance away is the second largest island, the island of San Biagio, also called "of the Rabbits" because in the 16th century there were numerous rabbits that offered abundant hunting.

stops.name: isola degli Olivi
stops.detail: Along the eastern shore are three other islands, all of modest size, located in the vicinity of Malcesine: the northernmost is the island of Olives, then there is the island of Dream, also reachable on foot from the coast during dry periods, and finally the southernmost, the island of Trimelone (or Tremellone).
